The avatar from beyond the stars has fallen before four true gods; madness retreats and uncontrolled extraordinary power grows still. The Fool, Evernight Goddess, Lord of Storms, and you have preserved this world. Having ascended to godhood, you joined them in the final divine war. Civilization survives at the brink of destruction, and the world has at last found redemption.
